cases.scenario: Promise.all of 5 initializeMemory calls on the same fresh home (the exact pattern server.ts uses: initializeMemory runs on EVERY memory.audit and memory.search RPC, and closure.ts runs it per queued intent)
cases.expected: all five resolve; concurrent boot is the normal case for this API
cases.observed: DEFECT. 4 of 5 calls rejected with "memory git init failed: fatal: cannot copy '.../templates/info/exclude' to '<root>/.git/info/exclude': File exists". Out-of-band probe: 8 of 8 rounds had at least one rejection, so this is deterministic, not flaky. Root cause is a TOCTOU between the stat() probe at packages/gateway/src/memory/doctrine.ts:63 and the unguarded `git init` at packages/gateway/src/memory/doctrine.ts:65 - every concurrent caller sees no .git and all of them run git init. Production impact: two concurrent memory.search/memory.audit RPCs against a corpus that has not been git-initialised yet (packages/gateway/src/server/server.ts:404 and :417) return an error to the client.

cases.class: B. migration / losslessness + C. audit semantics
cases.scenario: the `ops` axis root is a symlink to a directory OUTSIDE the memory root containing rules/smuggled.md and loose.md (loose.md is in no declared partition)
cases.expected: index and audit agree - anything the map serves and recall returns is also inspected by validateMemory, so ops/loose.md must raise axis_layout_violation
cases.observed: DEFECT. MEMORY.md lists both ops/rules/smuggled.md and ops/loose.md, searchMemory returns both, but validateMemory returns [] - zero issues. Cause: the audit walker at packages/gateway/src/memory/validator.ts:25 descends only on entry.isDirectory(), which is false for a symlink dirent, so the whole symlinked axis is skipped; meanwhile axisEntries (packages/gateway/src/memory/doctrine.ts:88-99) resolves the symlink through readdir and indexes it. Net effect: content living outside the memory root is mapped and recalled while being exempt from orphan_file, axis_layout_violation, duplicate_file_hash and out_of_root_link checks. Repro: symlink <root>/ops -> <home>/elsewhere, write elsewhere/loose.md, initializeMemory + regenerateMap, validateMemory -> [].

cases.scenario: smuggling attempts in one corpus: ops/../scratch/x.md, a directory literally named 'ops ' (trailing space), a prefix-sibling directory opsx/, ./ops/x.md, and daily/ops/rules/impostor.md

cases.scenario: MEMORY.md holds a dangling pointer to ops/rules/gone.md - a state the audit merely REPORTS as map_dangling - then searchMemory is called
cases.expected: recall degrades gracefully and still returns the real hit; a stale map is not a corrupt corpus
cases.observed: DEFECT. searchMemory rejects with ENOENT open '<root>/ops/rules/gone.md' at packages/gateway/src/memory/retrieve.ts:43 (the Promise.all over `files` readFiles every map pointer unconditionally). map_dangling was confirmed present, i.e. the audit treats this as a reportable-but-tolerated state while recall hard-fails. Production impact: one stale pointer in MEMORY.md takes down every memory.search RPC (packages/gateway/src/server/server.ts:417) until the map is regenerated. Repro: initializeMemory, append '- [ops/rules/gone.md](ops/rules/gone.md)' to MEMORY.md, call searchMemory.

cases.scenario: map pointers attempting to escape the root: percent-encoded %2e%2e/secret.md, daily/../../secret.md, and absolute /etc/hosts.md, with a real secret.md sitting one level above the memory root
cases.expected: recall never reads or surfaces content from outside the memory root
cases.observed: containment holds - the '..' and leading-'/' filters in retrieve.ts:17 drop the literal traversals, and the percent-encoded form is never decoded so it resolves to a non-existent path INSIDE the root. No hit path or excerpt contained the secret. (The resulting failure mode is the same unguarded readFile as D4.)
